[[File:Erik Simon.jpg|thumb|Erik Simon, 2004]]
'''Erik Simon''' (born 1950) is a German science fiction writer, editor of anthologies of science fiction, literary critic of science fiction, and translator.<ref>[https://archivsf.narod.ru/1950/erik_simon/index.htm Simon, Erik Симон Эрик (1950)]</ref><ref name=sofri>Sonja Fritzsche
, [https://library.oapen.org/bitstream/id/b6642e66-8442-41ef-8b6d-110725709e8a/1003375.pdf ''Science Fiction Literature in East Germany''], 2006, {{ISBN|978-3-03910-739-1}}</ref> 

==Biography==
Erik Simon was born in [[Dresden]]. He studied physics at [[TU Dresden]] and received qualifications of translator. For a short time he worked as an engineer at a concrete factory, since 1974 he became editor at the {{ill|Das Neue Berlin|de}} publishing house.  He translated many science fiction texts from Soviet Union, Bulgaria, Poland, Czechoslovakia, and Anglophone world.<ref>''[[Foundation (journal)|Foundation]]. The Review of Science Fiction'', [https://fanac.org/fanzines/Foundation/foundation_34_pringle_1985-fa.pdf  no. 34, 1985]</ref>{{pg|36}} Erik Simon was one of the key figures in science fiction publishing in [[GDR]]. He also contributed to theoretical research on the genre.<ref>[[Angela Steinmüller]], [[Karlheinz Steinmüller]], ''Vorgriff auf das Lichte Morgen. Studien zur DDR-Science-Fiction'', 1995</ref>{{pg|27-31}}

== Selected works==
*Simon, Erik and {{ill|Olaf R. Spittel|de}} , editors. ''Die Science-Fiction der DDR. Autoren und Werke: Ein Lexikon''. Das Neue Berlin, 1988.<ref>Helmut Fickelscherer, [https://berlingeschichte.de/lesezei/blz96_10/text04.htm "Die Etablierung eines Genres Bemerkungen zu: ''Die Science-fiction der DDR. Autoren und Werke''".]</ref>
*''[[Lichtjahr]]'' issues 1-7 (1980-1989); editor<ref>[https://archivsf.narod.ru/series/lichtyah.htm Lichtjahr Световой год]</ref>
*Short story collections: ''Sternbilder – Simon’s Fiction 1'' (2002) and ''Mondmysterien – Simon’s Fiction 2'' (2003) as well as ''Reisen von Zeit zu Zeit – Simon’s Fiction 3'' (2004) with Reinhard Heinrich. He also published two volumes of short stories prior to 1989: ''Fremder Sterne'' (Strange Stars, 1979) and ''Mondphantome, Erdbesucher'' (Moon Phantoms, Earth Visitors, 1987).<ref name=sofri/>

==Awards==
*1987: [[Eurocon]] award for editing a series of ''Lichtjahr'' ("Light Year") anthologies
*1989: {{ill|Wilhelm-Bracke-Medaille|de}} from German booksellers for editing work
[[Kurd Laßwitz Award]]:
* ''Von der Zeit, von der Erinnerung'' (best short story, 1992)
* ''Leichter als Vakuum'' (best short story, 1994) with [[Angela Steinmüller]] and [[Karlheinz Steinmüller]] as "Simon Zwystein"
* [[Vernor Vinge]]: ''Ein Feuer auf der Tiefe'' (Best translation, 1995)
* for ''Lichtjahr 7'' (special prize, 1999) together with the publisher Freundeskreis Science Fiction Leipzig e.V.
* ''Spiel beendet, sagte der Sumpf''  (best short story, 2002)
